item.title: Left-wing host blasts AOC as 'weak,' says she only engages critics who are 100% friendly
item.summary: Ana Kasparian criticized Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for what she called devastating "weakness" on Israel votes during a segment of "The Young Turks" Friday.

item.title: Singer D4vd arrested and held without bail in case tied to teen found dead in Tesla: Police
item.summary: Singer D4vd, whose real name is David Burke, was arrested in connection with the murder of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez in LA, LAPD says.

item.title: Rogan backs reality TV star Spencer Pratt’s bid for LA Mayor, says ‘I’d vote for you’
item.summary: Joe Rogan endorses Spencer Pratt for Los Angeles mayor, saying he would absolutely vote for the reality TV star if he still lived in California.

item.title: Missing pregnant woman found dead after mysterious Texas disappearance
item.summary: Ashanti Allen, a 23-year-old woman who disappeared while eight months pregnant, was found dead in Houston, her family confirmed. No arrests have been reported.

item.title: House punts Trump spy powers extension after conservatives block deal, forcing end-of-month showdown
item.summary: The FISA Section 702 surveillance program hit a temporary roadblock after House conservatives rejected a long-term extension early Friday morning.

item.title: Trump admin announces expansion of visa restriction policy in Western Hemisphere
item.summary: The State Department said it imposed visa restrictions on 26 individuals under the expanded policy targeting those acting for U.S. adversaries.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: NYC officials refuse ICE hold for illegal alien accused in arson that killed 4 and injured 7: DHS
item.summary: A Mexican national illegal alien accused of randomly setting a NYC apartment on fire that killed four could be released due to the city's sanctuary policies, DHS says.

item.title: Miami Catholic Charities loses $11M contract providing care for migrant children under Trump administration
item.summary: The Trump administration canceled an $11 million Catholic Charities contract in Miami, citing a drop in illegal immigration and fewer unaccompanied minors.

item.title: Franklin Graham defends Trump in letter shared on Truth Social after AI ‘Jesus’ image backlash
item.summary: Rev. Franklin Graham defended Trump over an AI-generated image controversy, saying the president thought it depicted a doctor helping someone, not Jesus.

item.title: Report details rising pressure on underground Catholics as China denies crackdown
item.summary: Human Rights Watch says China is increasing pressure on 12 million Catholics amid a decade-long campaign to align religion with party ideology.
